caption: A marshmallow on a stick is propped over a campfire, and it puffs, softens and sags.

sa.check: A marshmallow on a stick is propped over a campfire.
The marshmallow puffs up: it swells.
The stick is propped rather than held.
The side facing the fire changes first.
The puffing comes first and the sagging follows.

pc.expect: The change runs one way while the marshmallow is over the fire: it swells, goes glossy and slumps, and any darkening of the surface deepens.
pc.fail: The marshmallow firms up and regains its straight sides over the heat; or a darkened patch turns pale again; or it draws back to the shape it started with; or it alternates between puffed and flat.

pc.expect: The marshmallow behaves as a softening foam: it swells, its skin goes glossy and slack, and it stretches and droops around the stick.
pc.fail: The marshmallow keeps sharp square edges while glossy and sagging; or it runs off the stick as a thin liquid; or it crumbles dry; or it bounces on the stick like rubber.

pc.expect: The sag is downward: the soft marshmallow droops below the stick and any drip runs down.
pc.fail: The marshmallow droops upward or out sideways with nothing pushing it; or a drip climbs the stick; or the marshmallow lifts off the stick and hangs above it.

pc.expect: The change is strongest on the side toward the fire and the far side changes less.
pc.fail: The side away from the fire puffs and slumps while the side toward it stays firm; or the marshmallow changes evenly all round while the fire is plainly on one side; or a flame appears on the marshmallow while its surface stays white and unmarked.

pc.expect: One marshmallow on one stick; it stays on the stick and loses matter only by dripping or burning.
pc.fail: The marshmallow vanishes while still whole; or a second marshmallow appears; or the marshmallow splits into two whole marshmallows; or the stick passes through the marshmallow and it drops off.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The stick, the fire's logs and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stick changes colour or length; or the logs rearrange; or the background changes between frames.

note: Browning or blackening of the marshmallow is chemistry and is not judged in itself; what is judged is that any darkening deepens and does not fade.
